instruction: act-now.html has too many button variants, it's visually confusing.
what_changed: Every button-like control in the page body is now a member of the standard .btn family: one primary (.btn--cta, solid orange) and one secondary (.btn--ghost, transparent with a teal border). The Donate / Report an odor pair keeps its square corners and joins the family. No new classes, no new colours.

distinct_treatments.note: Chrome (masthead 'Act now' pill, footer social pills, footer Donate) is shared by all 18 pages and is out of scope for this page's controls, so it is inventoried and left alone.

inventory_before.method: computed styles in headless Chrome at 1440 CSS px via bb browser-automation, not read from the stylesheet

page_content.label: Donate
page_content.own_treatment: third style: a local block re-declaring border, fill, colour, padding, min-height, type, underline reset and focus ring

page_content.label: Report an odor
page_content.markup: Report an odor inside the same list

chrome_out_of_scope.label: Act now
chrome_out_of_scope.why_left_alone: shared masthead across all 18 pages, pinned by its own contrast test and its own aria-current outline rule

chrome_out_of_scope.label: Donate (footer)
chrome_out_of_scope.why_left_alone: already a family primary; nothing to consolidate

chrome_out_of_scope.label: X / Facebook (footer social)
chrome_out_of_scope.why_left_alone: social links, not page actions; shared footer

inventory_before.note_on_brief: The brief named a 'City Council emails ghost button'. No such control exists on the page: there is exactly one .btn--ghost in the built HTML (the Sign now pill), and the councilor addresses render as ordinary prose links in the contact list. Counted as written, not as described.

inventory_after.method: same measurement, same width, after the change

page_content.label: Donate
page_content.changed: radius kept square; fill, border colour, padding, weight and the underline reset now come from the family; height 65 -> 54

layout_checks.no_collision: at 1440 the pair occupies y=926..980 and the Email the Council CTA y=1116..1170, so 136px of clearance and the lede paragraph sits between them; the pills above and below are unmoved
layout_checks.no_label_wrap: Report an odor stays on one line at all three widths (252px box at 768/1440, 372px at 412)
layout_checks.width_floor_holds: 14rem = 252px at the 18px root, preserved at both desktop widths
layout_checks.touch_target: 54px tall, above the 48px minimum row 82 asked for, so deleting the explicit min-height loses nothing
layout_checks.other_pages: the build changed only docs/act-now.html and docs/styles.css; the other 22 built pages are byte-identical, and every changed rule is prefixed .link-row--buttons, which appears on act-now.html alone (test-pinned)

focus_ring.method: real Tab presses in headless Chrome, reading getComputedStyle(outline) on the focused element
focus_ring.why_the_loud_ring_stayed_local: The .btn family declares no focus ring at all, so there is no duplicate to delete. A single teal ring cannot serve the dark masthead and footer surfaces where .btn also appears (teal-900 on teal-900 is invisible), so promoting it into the family would have made two controls' rings disappear. The pair sits on white, where the loud ring belongs, so it stays on the pair. The two pills' default rings are unchanged from before this row.
